exposure: Assisted reproductive technologies (IVF or ovulation induction)
cohort: 8244 singleton pregnancies of women aged at least 40 years who delivered between January 1, 1991, and December 31, 2013, at Soroka University Medical Center, Beer Sheva, Israel
finding: Among patients of advanced maternal age, ART were independently associated with increased FGR and preterm delivery rates compared with spontaneous pregnancies; perinatal mortality was comparable.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in pregnancies conceived via ART compared to spontaneous conception.
